difficulty_reason: Beyond the ordinary RSK and highest-weight crystal prerequisites, the authors define column-sensitive multiset crystal operators and prove that their word positions, semistandardness and partial inverses are preserved. A new single-column crystal isomorphism supplies the building blocks for a column-by-column uncrowding construction that records growth in strictly column-flagged increasing skew tableaux. The inverse uses evacuation and reverse RSK with a recursively constructed recording tableau, identifying every component multiplicity rather than merely applying ordinary single-tableau RSK; these new compatibility and inverse-construction obligations exceed routine doctoral qualifying exercises.
